tables.name: PLAYER_COLLISION_HANDLER_TABLE
tables.dispatch: The pass doubles the actor type twice and indexes the table with the resulting type*4 offset.
tables.bound: cmpi.b #0x7F,(A1); bcc skips types 0x7F and above.

tables.name: ACTOR_COLLISION_HANDLER_TABLE
tables.dispatch: The pass doubles the receiving actor type twice and indexes the table with the resulting type*4 offset.
tables.bound: cmpi.b #0x32,(A2); bcc skips receiving types 0x32 and above.

verification.adjacency: The player table ends immediately before the actor table; the actor table ends before the following non-dispatch data.

conclusion: The collision dispatch extents are determined by the consumers' type guards rather than the previous 256-byte fallback ranges.
